subject.title: [Bug]: Discord sends failed during a full network outage are dropped on reconnect (send_attempt_started refuses replay, no reconcileUnknownSend)

question: Should this gap be fixed generically in core by clearing/replaying only proven pre-dispatch network failures, or in Discord by adding unknown-send reconciliation before replay?
rationale: Both viable fixes affect the durable delivery duplicate-vs-loss contract, and the repository already treats ambiguous-send recovery as a maintainer-approved behavior boundary rather than a purely mechanical patch.

options.title: Approve a narrow core pre-dispatch fix
options.body: Classify only transport errors that are proven not to have crossed the platform boundary as replayable, and cover the behavior with core recovery tests plus live Discord proof.

options.title: Require Discord reconciliation first
options.body: Add a Discord-specific unknown-send reconciliation/idempotency path before replaying any `send_attempt_started` entry.

options.title: Leave broad ambiguity manual
options.body: Keep the current no-blind-replay behavior until a broader delivery ledger or UI surfacing design is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core pre-dispatch fix
recommendation.body: Classify only transport errors that are proven not to have crossed the platform boundary as replayable, and cover the behavior with core recovery tests plus live Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for both durable outbound lifecycle and Discord retry behavior.
